verdict.rationale: Embedded checkout components are a fair axis for a payments platform, but the evidence never mentions embeddable or customizable UI components (inline/popup checkout, elements). It only says payments can be collected 'from your app or website' and via the API. Those are generic collection and API building blocks that do not establish embedded components rather than a hosted redirect.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page
